# s4communication_communication_user (Resource)

Manages an SAP S/4HANA Cloud Communication User.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "s4communication_communication_user" "example" {
  name        = "EXT_API_USER"
  description = "User for the external API"
  password    = var.communication_user_password
}

variable "communication_user_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Communication User Name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Communication User Description
- `is_locked` (Boolean) Is the user locked
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Communication User Password. SAP requires more than 20 characters with at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter and one special character. SAP never returns the password, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected and it is not imported.
- `type` (String) Communication User Type, defaults to `customer_communication`. Changing this forces a new user to be created.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Communication User ID, assigned by SAP

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Terraform 1.12 and later: import with the resource identity, as listed by
# terraform query
import {
  to = s4communication_communication_user.example
  identity = {
    id = "CC0000000001"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) Communication user ID, assigned by SAP

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Communication users are imported by the ID assigned by SAP. The password is
# not returned by SAP and has to be set in the configuration again.
terraform import s4communication_communication_user.example CC0000000001
```
